answer: Bindings are kept in copper, verified in harbor, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mesa check. Each duplicate costs another 25 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
